benefits: Build keyword lists for SEO and ads in seconds instead of hours in a spreadsheet.
Brainstorm brand names, product names and domain ideas from word parts.
Generate test data and product variants (color + size + model) for QA and catalogs.
Combine prefixes, suffixes and separators without writing any formulas.
Runs entirely in the browser — paste sensitive keyword lists with confidence.

faqs.a: A word combiner takes every word in list A and pairs it with every word in list B. So A = red, blue and B = apple, banana produces red apple, red banana, blue apple, blue banana.
faqs.q: What does a word combiner do?

faqs.a: Type or paste one word per line in each box. You can also separate words with commas or semicolons — newlines, commas and semicolons are all treated as separators.
faqs.q: How do I enter my word lists?

faqs.a: The total is list A count times list B count. 20 words in each list gives 400 combinations. Output is capped at 5,000 lines to keep the browser fast.
faqs.q: How many combinations will I get?

faqs.a: Yes. Choose Custom as the separator and type any text up to 10 characters — a space, a dash, or even words like vs or and.
faqs.q: Can I use a custom separator?

faqs.a: The optional prefix is added before every combination and the optional suffix after every combination. They are handy for campaign tags or fixed brand words.
faqs.q: What are the prefix and suffix for?

faqs.a: No. Everything is computed locally in JavaScript. Your word lists never leave your device.
faqs.q: Are my word lists uploaded anywhere?

faqs.a: Use the Download button to save all combinations as a .txt file, one per line — ready to open in Excel or Google Sheets.
faqs.q: How do I get the results into Excel?

word-combiner.formula:
lists: A = [a1..am], B = [b1..bn]
line(i, j) = prefix + ai + separator + bj + suffix
output = every line(i, j) for i in 1..m, j in 1..n
total = m x n  (capped at 5,000 displayed lines)
if remove-duplicates: skip lines already seen
howTo: Enter your first word list in box A — one word per line (commas work too).
Enter your second word list in box B the same way.
Choose a separator: space, hyphen, underscore, or a custom one.
Optionally add a prefix, a suffix, and toggle duplicate removal.
Combinations appear instantly in the output box.
Copy them or download as a .txt file for Excel.
keyFacts: Every word in list A is paired with every word in list B (cartesian product).
Words can be separated by newlines, commas or semicolons.
Total combinations = words in A x words in B.
Separators: space, hyphen, underscore, or any custom text up to 10 characters.
Optional prefix/suffix wrap every combination; duplicate removal is on by default.
Output is capped at 5,000 lines so the page stays fast.

limitations: The display is capped at 5,000 lines; very large lists (e.g. 100 x 100 = 10,000 combos) show only the first 5,000 on screen.
Combinations grow multiplicatively — 500 x 500 words would create 250,000 lines and may slow older devices.
Duplicate removal compares exact text; red apple and Red apple count as different lines.
The tool pairs words mechanically and cannot judge whether a combination makes sense.

word-combiner.workedExample:
List A:  red, blue
List B:  apple, banana
Separator: space

Step 1: parse lists -> A = [red, blue] (2 words), B = [apple, banana] (2 words)
Step 2: total = 2 x 2 = 4 combinations
Step 3: pair every word of A with every word of B:
  red + apple  -> "red apple"
  red + banana -> "red banana"
  blue + apple -> "blue apple"
  blue + banana -> "blue banana"

Result: 4 lines, ready to copy or download.
